name: Compile tractmeasures csvs across project into one dataframe
summary: Concatenates tractmeasures csv files from many subjects into one csv, adding subject, session, tag and datatype-tag columns with pandas; a group-analysis utility.
description: Reads each input tractmeasures csv, adds subjectID, sessionID, tags and datatype_tags columns from the brainlife input metadata when they are missing, and stacks all rows into output/tractmeasures.csv. Use it to build one dataframe of tract profiles or measures across a project; for DSI Studio tractmeasures use the DSI Studio-specific App.

inputs.description: tractmeasures csv files of several subjects/sessions (one per input).

outputs.description: Single csv (tractmeasures.csv) with all input rows plus subjectID, sessionID, tags and datatype_tags columns.

failure_modes.fix: Check the log for a pandas error reading one of the input csv files.
